Delhi Woman Abused in Moving Car, Suspect Arrested

A 29-year-old man has been arrested for allegedly abducting and assaulting a cab driver who died after a chase. The incident occurred when the victim was lured out of her car for food, leading to a violent confrontation. The suspect's arrest brings some relief to the family of the deceased driver.
